artworks.title: Man in Chains
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on the floor with their head resting on fabric. The person's facial features are indistinct, and they have short, curly hair. They are wearing a loose garment that covers most of their body, with folds creating shadows and highlights. The person is barefoot, and their legs are secured by a tool or restraint device attached to chains or ropes. In the background, there are architectural elements like a wall with a doorway or window and a structure made of large blocks or bricks.

artworks.title: Male Saint Standing, with Folded Arms, Facing to the Left
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized full-body view of a figure standing. The figure is positioned with their body turned slightly to the side, one arm across the chest and the other draped by fabric. The facial features are obscured due to the stylized nature, but they appear to have a prominent nose and jutting chin, with long flowing hair merging into the background. The person is draped in textured robes that suggest movement, possibly indicating a cloak or garment. A circular halo-like element is above the figure's head. The background consists of two tones, yellowish and brown, with a textural quality, and there is text in the bottom right corner. The color palette is harmonious with earth tones integrated into the figure's robes and surroundings.

artworks.title: Male Saint Standing, with Folded Arms, Facing to the Left
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in ochre and olive green
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with crossed arms, facing to the side. Their head is turned to the left. The person has a beard and windswept hair. They wear a flowing garment gathered at the waist, revealing their lower legs and feet. Above their head is a subtle halo. The background consists of a plain texture with abstract outlines resembling a landscape, and there is text on the right side.

artworks.title: Algernon Sidney
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Justus van Verus
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in tan, light brown, light gray, and dark gray
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a head-and-shoulders portrait facing to his right. He has long, curly hair, prominent facial features, and a solemn expression. He wears a dark-colored coat with ornate detailing, a white cravat at his neck. The background is textured, with an oval and rectangle. Below the portrait is an inscription describing a historical event involving Algernon Sidney and a controversial verse.

artworks.title: The Dissolute Household
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring fantastical elements and domestic activity. The image presents a busy, cluttered room filled with various characters engaged in different activities. In the foreground, several small figures are energetically engaged in tasks such as carrying baskets and playing. A seated figure on the left looks contemplative or exhausted as a child leans on them. In the background, adults are working on different trades, with one figure mending or crafting shoes at a bench. Another figure appears to be managing the chaos. The walls carry hung shoes and a framed artwork depicting a narrative scene. The floor is patterned with tiles, and there is an air of a workshop or domestic setting, as indicated by the tools and items scattered around. The image is richly detailed.

artworks.title: The Procuress
artworks.medium: color chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four people in conversation, with two central figures exchanging a document or object. The figures are depicted in an elaborate scene, each adorned in richly textured clothing. The characters engage with one another, creating a narrative of dialogue or exchange. The artwork is rendered with a high degree of contrast using bold lines and shading, capturing the expressive features and gestures of the figures.

artworks.title: Artist Painting a Nude Woman: Allegory of Visual Perception
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print of an allegorical scene featuring various symbols of arts and sciences. Closest to us, there is a winged cherub holding a rectangular mirror up to a kneeling, semi-nude woman on the right who is draped in fabric. The woman seems to look down at her reflection in the mirror. Behind the cherub, an old man appears to paint the woman, looking towards her as he holds his brush up to the canvas. Three more men are partially visible behind him, all seeming to use tools related to measurement. More tools and objects are scattered on the ground. There is a cat sitting near the bottom-left corner, and a bird flying in the sky near the upper-right corner. In the sky above is a radiant sun, casting light over the background of mountains and a calm sea with ships.

artworks.title: Saint James of Compostela
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a person on horseback holding a flag aloft, accompanied by another figure with a curved sword. There is a small cherubic face with wings in the upper left corner, surrounded by clouds. The background is textured, enhancing the overall composition of the scene.

artworks.title: Hercules Fighting the Fury and the Discord
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a giant figure holding a club. The composition includes a powerful, muscular figure on rocky terrain. Above the figure, there is a small winged cherub. The giant is entangled with serpentine shapes. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing muscles, textures, and a dynamic style inspired by Greco-Roman mythology. Strong lines and shading create depth and tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Agatha
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a historical scene with multiple figures standing on varying levels. In the center is a woman on a raised platform, surrounded by other figures, including a soldier standing to her left. Behind the woman, another figure is partially obscured. Above them, an angelic figure with wings and curly hair is depicted amidst swirling clouds, gazing at a flaming heart. In the background, there is a large fluted column supporting the setting. The scene is depicted with fine lines to enhance textures.

artworks.title: Three Peasants and a Woman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a sloped terrain where a group of four figures is gathered. The figures wear broad-brimmed hats and stand in a circle with their backs to the viewer. Lush trees are depicted on the left, with dense foliage created through fine lines. A possible old ruin is faintly visible amidst the trees. The horizon line is low in the image, beyond the figures. The artwork is detailed and etched intricately, particularly in the depiction of trees and figures. The image is monochrome with crisp lines, highlighting the detailed scene.

artworks.title: Woman and Child Standing near a Seated Peasant
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures outdoors, with two men and a child in the foreground. One man is riding a small donkey, while another stands nearby. In the background, there is a dirt path, trees, and faint figures and possible structures in the distance. The image has a monochromatic color palette with intricate lines depicting details in the landscape.

artworks.title: Woman Conversing with a Peasant
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic, pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the composition, revealing a distant landscape blending into the sky. The scene features meticulous linework with intricate hatching to depict texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast between dark lines and a lighter background. Two figures in robes and hats stand near a rustic structure, while a child is seen near a path leading into the landscape. Trees and shrubs populate the background, with a gnarled tree framing the top half of the image.

artworks.title: Soldier Receiving an Order from a Sitting Officer
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural scene depicting a village or countryside. It shows figures engaging in tasks with dilapidated structures and trees in the background. The horizon is obscured by trees and buildings. The etching features intricate line work detailing textures of trees, walls, and clothing. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly brown and sepia. In the distance, a figure on horseback and trees are visible.

artworks.title: Lion Hunt
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with dynamic movement and tension. Figures are engaged in combat on horseback, with rearing horses. The scene is close and crowded, with overlapping figures. Warriors wield weapons and have intense expressions. The detailed line work emphasizes clothing, armor, and musculature. The sky above has stormy clouds.

artworks.title: Birth of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, both adults and children, in a busy composition. A woman in the center holds an infant, draped in fabric, with other women around her. One woman holds a bowl beside the seated woman, while another stands with a basket on her head. The people have classical facial features common in Renaissance art. An older bearded man near the center appears to have a glowing halo. The individuals wear flowing garments. In the clouds above, an older figure with a robe and beard is surrounded by cherubs or angelic children. The background has swirling clouds around the divine figures looking down on the earthly gathering.

artworks.title: Christ among the Doctors
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The composition showcases a detailed scene with multiple figures gathered around a central figure seated on a raised platform. Surrounding the central figure are others, some gesturing upwards. The figures are draped in flowing robes, with an emphasis on intricate folds and gestures. The background features an ornate architectural structure with grand arches and twisted columns. The use of shading indicates depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor setting with classical architectural elements. The scene features a stone well as the focal point, surrounded by characters. In the background, there is a stone wall leading up to a round building with a dome and small windows. The setting combines natural elements like dense foliage with classical stonework. The color scheme includes various shades of brown, adding to the historic ambiance.

artworks.title: Death of a Holy Friar
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This is a painting of angelic and monastic figures. The artwork features winged cherubs or angels amidst clouds, with one prominent angel positioned in the center pointing upwards. Below, several monastic figures, clad in robes, are gathered in various postures. One figure is reclined, with a book and other religious symbols close by. The overall composition is imbued with sacred elements, using light and shadow to create depth and focus. This is in the style of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo.

artworks.title: Death of the Magdalene
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure surrounded by cherubs and angels. The central figure is sleeping peacefully, holding a cross, while cherubs and angels play various instruments around them. The background includes rocky formations and delicate plant life.

artworks.title: Death of Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure accompanied by celestial beings and a lion. The image depicts a male figure resting on a draped surface, surrounded by four winged beings and a lion. The celestial beings are positioned dynamically around the reclining figure, one appears to be engaged with the male figure directly. The background features swirling cloud forms. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic palette with ink and wash, emphasizing fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This drawing features a religious scene with a large cross and multiple figures. Some figures are surrounding the cross, while one figure is climbing it with a ladder. Other figures at the base of the cross are handling a body in a reverent or mournful manner. The expressions and gestures of the figures convey a sense of collective sorrow. The artwork is done in sepia tones with a style reminiscent of 'Jacopo da Pontormo' or another Mannerist artist, featuring elongated forms and expressive postures.

artworks.title: Funeral Procession of a Saint with Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with ornate columns, angels, and individuals in devotional postures. The scene depicts an interior setting with architectural elements like columns and arches. Two angels are shown at the center top, with wings extended. Below them, church figures are seen holding torches or staffs, with some kneeling, bowing, or engaged in acts of worship. The group is gathered around a gravestone-like structure draped in fabric. The drawing features intricate detailing on the figures' robes.

artworks.title: Last Communion of Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and brown ink, and brown wash, heightened with white, on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: This drawing depicts angels interacting with a reclined figure in a celestial setting. Several winged figures are shown amidst clouds, some holding objects like a chalice and a radiant orb. The central figure is reclining on a surface with tattered clothing, surrounded by symbolic items including an open book with a skull on it. A lion is peacefully lying beside the central figure. The composition is done in shades of brown with dynamic forms typical of Baroque religious artwork.
